acceptance: Remote OpenSSH Unix socket is mode 0660 with the managed group before tunnel status becomes online.
A chmod preparation failure kills the tunnel and enters bounded reconnect without exposing a public TCP port.
Design, operations docs, and deterministic tests no longer claim client StreamLocalBindMask controls remote permissions.
exact_next_action: Implement a strict secondary SSH chmod preparation step, unit-test success/failure lifecycle, update design/docs, and rerun the real stream-local canary.
